newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: ARGENTINA CUTS 1996/97 MAIZE ESTIMATE BY 203,000 T.
newsitem.headline: ARGENTINA CUTS 1996/97 MAIZE ESTIMATE BY 203,000 T.

text.p: Argentina's Agriculture Secretariat said Tuesday it had cut its estimate of 1996/97 maize production to 14.496 million tonnes from 14.699 million tonnes.
It slightly reduced its estimate of wheat output to 15.983 million tonnes from 15.985 million tonnes but edged up its sorghum number to 2.552 million tonnes from 2.496 million tonnes.

It said soybean output was 11.013 million tonnes, marginally up from an earlier figure of 11.009 million tonnes. Sunflower seed production was 5.021 million tonnes, compared to the previous estimate of 5.062 million tonnes.
The Secretariat estimated barley production of 441,000 tonnes, compared to earlier estimates of 441,000 tonnes of brewers' barley and 4,000 tonnes of forrage barley.
It left and its cotton figure steady at 1.017 million tonnes, but increased its estimate of peanut production to 282,000 tonnes from 265,000 tonnes.
Sugar cane output was 11.814 million tonnes in 1996/97, the Secretariat said. No earlier forecast was available.
Overall 1996/97 grain production was 52.834 million tonnes, slightly down from the earlier figure of 52.983 million tonnes.
